title: Warm-boot CPA traffic handling
author: abdosi
body:
Issue#

During CPA time-window following traffic consideration can be added to existing test case 

- Traffic coming from uplink (VxLAN Traffic)  should be decapsulated and L2 forwarded and not flooded if MAC is Learnt. Some of SAI implementaion it gets flooded even though Downstream MAC is known

- All the Uplink Path should have VxLAN encapsulated traffic. This to make sure traffic from all uplink can be forwarded.

- Mirroring of AR Traffic should happen in complete duration from CPA Installation and then removal. Current SONiC there is small window post-warmboot here Traffic is not mirror even though CPA is not removed yet.

comments.author: jcaiMR
comments.body:
Test case 1 – non broadcast ARP Reply 

Test objective 

Verify ARP Reply for known mac is not broadcast to server during warm-reboot 

 

Test steps 

Server (PTF) enable GARP service, ARP entry learnt on tor 

Trigger Warm-Reboot, PTF send ARP Request from Port Ethernet-A 

Verify ARP Reply received only on Ethernet-A (non-broadcast) 

Clear ARP Entry, PTF send ARP Request from Port Ethernet-A 

Verify ARP Reply received on multi-interfaces 

Check if Warm-Reboot timeout, and finish test case post check 

 

Test case 2 – ARP Request to ferret server 

Test objective 

Verify during Warm-Reboot, ARP Request from server send to ferret 

 

Test steps 

Server (PTF) enable GARP service, check ARP entry learnt on interface 

Trigger Warm-Reboot 

Start new thread and in this thread let PTF periodically send ARP Request from Port Ethernet-A, check send counter X.  

Wait and show everflow ACL counter 

Verify X matches everflow acl counter increase, verify ARP Reply received from Ethernet-A 

Check if Warm-Reboot timeout, and finish test case post check (join new thread ...) 

 

 

Test Case 3 – ARP Reply from ferret server During Warm-Reboot 

Test objective 

Verify during Warm-Reboot, ARP Reply all comes from ferret server and in vxlan encap  

 

Test steps 

Server (PTF) enable GARP service, check ARP entry learnt on interface 

Clear related interface counters, vxlan counter, Everflow ACL counters 

Trigger Warm-Reboot, PTF send ARP Request from Port Ethernet-A, check send counter X 

Show everflow ACL counter match send counter X, PTF received ARP Reply from Ethernet-A and counter matches X (refer to Note) 

Verify vxlan packets counter matches X (refer to Note) 

Check if Warm-Reboot timeout, and finish test case post check 

Note: It's hard to determine when warm-reboot starts, so counter send counter X may always large than everflow ACL and VXLAN counters, to simplify the test case, we can just monitor the increase value of acl and vxlan counters)

linkedPullRequests.author: jcaiMR
linkedPullRequests.body:
### Description of PR
Fix test gap for CPA feature.
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/4284

Add following test case to cover.

```
Test case 1 – non broadcast ARP Reply
Test objective: Verify ARP Reply for known mac is not broadcast to server during warm-reboot
Test steps:
   1. Trigger Warm-Reboot, PTF send ARP Request from Port Ethernet-A
   2. Verify ARP Reply received only on Ethernet-A (non-broadcast)
   3. Check if Warm-Reboot timeout, and finish test case post check

Test case 2 – ARP Request to ferret server
Test objective: Verify during Warm-Reboot, ARP Request from server send to ferret
Test steps:
  1. Trigger Warm-Reboot
  2. Start new thread and in this thread let PTF periodically send ARP Request from Port Ethernet-A, check send counter X.
  3. Wait and show everflow ACL counter
  4. Verify X matches everflow acl counter increase, verify ARP Reply received from Ethernet-A
  5. Check if Warm-Reboot timeout, and finish test case post check (join new thread ...)

Test Case 3 – ARP Reply from ferret server During Warm-Reboot
Test objective: Verify during Warm-Reboot, ARP Reply all comes from ferret server and in vxlan encap
Test steps:
  1. Clear related interface counters, vxlan counter, Everflow ACL counters
  2. Trigger Warm-Reboot, PTF send ARP Request from Port Ethernet-A, check send counter X
  3. Show everflow ACL counter match send counter X, PTF received ARP Reply from Ethernet-A and counter matches X (refer to Note)
  4. Verify vxlan packets counter matches X (refer to Note)
  5. Check if Warm-Reboot timeout, and finish test case post check

Note: 
It's hard to determine when warm-reboot starts, so counter send counter X may always large than everflow ACL and VXLAN counters, to simplify the test case, we can just monitor the increase value of acl and vxlan counters)
Due to show vxlan counter not work, currently only check vxlan tunnel status during warm-reboot
```

Summary:
Fixes #4284

- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [x] Test case(new/improvement)


### Back port request
- [ ] 201911
- [ ] 202012
- [x] 202205

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Fix test gap

#### How did you do it?
Add test case for address resolution traffic during warm-reboot

#### How did you verify/test it?
Verify on DUT

comments.author: vaibhavhd
comments.body:
> I also have same question as Storm. The test gap mentions a few more asks on verification. Where are below cases being verified?
> 
> 1. L2 forwarded traffic is NOT broadcasted when the MAC is learnt?
> 2. Mirroring of traffic happens for the entire duration -- CPA creation to CPA removal? This PR checks for increment of ACL counter. However, this still not verifies if the mirroring happened for the entire duration of CPA existence.

@jcaiMR can you also address these questions? Thanks!

comments.author: jcaiMR
comments.body:
> > I also have same question as Storm. The test gap mentions a few more asks on verification. Where are below cases being verified?
> > 
> > 1. L2 forwarded traffic is NOT broadcasted when the MAC is learnt?
> > 2. Mirroring of traffic happens for the entire duration -- CPA creation to CPA removal? This PR checks for increment of ACL counter. However, this still not verifies if the mirroring happened for the entire duration of CPA existence.
> 
> @jcaiMR can you also address these questions? Thanks!

Sorry Vaibhav, I may missed some comments.

1. layer2 not broadcast by PTF side verify Arp reply come from same port as we send Arp request. If ARP reply broadcasted, packet verify will failure. Like previous dual-tor issue in static route scripts, with wrong mac packet broadcasted and packet verify failure.  Related diff is here:
```
            testutils.send_packet(self, port, pkt)
            # check arp reply should come from same port
            # clean arp, test broadcast reply if needed
            testutils.verify_packet_any_port(self, exp_pkt, ports=[port])
```

2. the test method here is:
Waiting for CPA create ferret everflow table -> start to send arp request -> verify everflow acl increase (This verify arp request send out through mirror)

For ARP reply, I plan to use folowing logic:

vxlan table created -> ptf received arp reply -> verify vxlan rx ounter increase 

But after sync with Prince Sunny and also based on my testing result, currently we don't have way to verify vxlan decap packets (On some platform it does not support vxlan decap packets counting). In PR we just check vxlan table created. So at this moment we can't fully verify ferret downlink stream.
